title: 11月の行事と暮らし
subject_en: Items and small scenes for November in Japan, cute and friendly, each ONE object centred in its cell Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: 立冬・文化の日・焼き芋・新米・紅葉狩りなど、11月の行事と暮らしの素材12点です。月初のおたよりや店頭の掲示に使えます。
items: a scarf and mittens on a small branch with the first fallen leaves
a medal-like badge with a book, a paintbrush and a flower
a roasted sweet potato split open with steam, wrapped in newspaper
a bowl of fresh white rice with a bundle of rice ears beside it
a picnic mat with a flask and sweets under falling red maple leaves
a large decorated lucky rake (kumade) with a gold coin and a lucky cat
a string of persimmons hung to dry under the eaves
a kotatsu table with a quilt and a basket of mandarin oranges
a bouquet of small flowers tied with a ribbon and a thank-you card
a bowl of chestnuts with spiky burrs beside it
a small kerosene heater with a kettle steaming on top
a clay pot on a portable burner with ingredients ready around it
